title: fix: pin the docs Scalar script and redirect the origin host
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Direct visits to gen.myceli.ai/docs now get a 302 redirect to gen.pollinations.ai/docs, preserving the query string; requests proxied through gen.pollinations.ai are served without a redirect loop. The docs page loads the pinned Scalar 1.74.0 standalone script with a SHA-384 integrity check and crossorigin attribute, so the browser verifies the CDN file before running it.
